Step 1: Calculate the volume of the hole Bob needs to dig. The dimensions are 6 feet long, 4 feet wide, and 3 feet deep.
Volume = length $\times$ width $\times$ depth
Volume = $6 \times 4 \times 3 = 72$ cubic feet.

Step 2: Determine the time it takes to shovel the earth. It takes 3 seconds to shovel one cubic foot.
Total time = Volume $\times$ time per cubic foot
Total time = $72 \text{ cubic feet} \times 3 \text{ seconds/cubic foot} = 216$ seconds.

Final answer: 216
